description: Compare current validation violations against a saved baseline to detect the impact of rule or scanner changes. Run validate with --save-baseline before changing rules, then run again after to see the diff.

do.description: Save a baseline before modifying rules or scanners, then compare after

guidance.description: Baseline captures violation snapshot. After rule/scanner change, diff shows new violations, resolved violations, and severity changes.
example: Before change: save baseline with 12 violations
After change: 10 violations remain, 2 resolved, 3 new -> net impact visible

dont.description: Do not modify rules without checking impact

guidance.description: Changing rules without a baseline means you cannot measure impact. Always save a baseline first.
example: No baseline: 'No baseline found' info message shown
Stale baseline: results may not reflect recent changes
